Providing guidance and training to staff on proper medical record documentation, organization, and security practices. Proficiency in using medical recordkeeping and health information management systems, as well as standard office software applications. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail to ensure accurate and efficient record maintenance. Ability to handle sensitive patient information with discretion and professionalism. High school diploma or equivalent. Employees must read, speak, and comprehend English to the extent that they can perform the contract requirements and comply with installation emergency procedures. Passport must be valid for a minimum of one (1) year or more at the time of hiring. Ability to obtain country-specific visas per the U.S. Department of State Foreign Clearance Guide. Ability to successfully pass contract medical requirements and maintain compliance throughout the duration of deployment. Must be able to obtain and maintain facility credentials/authorization. Procedure Compliance: Each employee must read, understand, and implement the general and specific operational, safety, quality, and environmental requirements of all plans, procedures, and policies pertaining to the job. Physical Requirements Requirements may include prolonged sitting, standing, walking, climbing stairs, lifting up to 25 pounds regularly and 50 pounds occasionally, and working in both indoor and outdoor environments. review_candidates.description: Job Summary Head of Family Office, Southeast Asia will be joining the overseas team of FamilyOfficeHK at the Jakarta ETO under its Dedicated Team for Attracting Businesses and Talents / Investment Promotion Unit, to help Family Offices from Southeast Asia set up and expand their presence in Hong Kong. He/ she will work closely with the Invest Hong Kong (InvestHK) global network and the Hong Kong Economic and Trade Offices (HKETO) in major cities around the world. Main Duties And Responsibilities To engage and assist target Family Offices in Southeast Asia in establishing or expanding their operations in Hong Kong, providing high-quality services and support, as well as execute their landing in Hong Kong; To proactively reach out to targets through marketing activities, promotional campaigns, and individual visits, and to identify and generate new leads for target Family Offices while maintaining updated information on activities, status, targets, and feedback to track KPIs; To coordinate with industry partners, government bodies, and relevant parties in Southeast Asia to participate in promotional events, such as round-tables, seminars, and duty visits, to promote Hong Kong as a global hub for Family Offices and identify target opportunities; To assist InvestHK Head Office and the Head of Business and Talent Attraction / Investment Promotion in driving inward investment promotion and talent attraction efforts into Hong Kong from markets under the purview of Jakarta ETO, covering all sectors identified by InvestHK Head Office; To provide timely advice and practical assistance to potential investors and to organise or support investment promotion visits by InvestHK Head Office; To monitor markets developments, trends, regulatory changes, and business intelligence while gathering market feedback and business sentiments, in order to effectively address client needs regarding Family Offices in Southeast Asia; and to collaborate with the Headquarters Family Office team in Hong Kong on investment promotion activities and other ad-hoc tasks assigned by the Global Head (Family Office); To manage systematic records of contacts, leads, and promotional activities, provide administrative and reporting support for investment promotion and HKETO initiatives as required, and perform any other duties as assigned by senior officers; Support the HKETO in attracting talents to Hong Kong; and Support the HKETO activities as and when required. The ideal candidate should Possess strong track record of business development, generating leads and successfully managing client relationships in Southeast Asia; Have good presentation and public speaking skills to represent InvestHK to speak at different Family Office related activities; Have the ability to be discreet and respectful of UHNWIs' privacy and the ability for the latter to entrust him/her with handling of their queries and issues; Possess the ability to manage multiple touchpoints and respond quickly to changes in priorities, and that to work in cross-cultural environment and experience in managing needs and dealing with demanding requests from clients; Have previous experience in collaborating with both internal and external stakeholders on event management, client support and outreach programmes; Be able to work independently under pressure to meet performance targets and as a team player; and Be required to travel in the region. Entry Requirements A Bachelor's degree or equivalent; a higher degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, Accounting or Marketing would be an advantage; A minimum of 6 years of proven working experience in international sales and/or business development; Excellent presentation and communication skills in English; proficiency in any Southeast Asia languages would be an advantage; Relevant experience in and broad knowledge of Southeast Asia are important; experiences of living and/or doing business in Hong Kong would be an asset; and Eligible to take up employment in Indonesia without arrangement of work visa by the employer. Terms of Appointment On a contract basis as locally-engaged staff of the Jakarta ETO up to 31 March 2029. Benefits Festive allowance (THR) and BPJS benefits; Medical, maternity and dental benefits; and vacation leave. Application Method Please provide (1) Cover Letter; and (2) Resume in English with contact number and email address to Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office . Candidates may submit by EMAIL to job@hketojakarta.gov.hk and should ensure that the documents reach Jakarta ETO before the closing date for applications. On receipt of applications, Jakarta ETO will issue an acknowledgement of application to the candidates. Short-listed candidates will be invited for an interview, which may include a written test. All invited candidates, including those residing outside Jakarta, should make their own arrangements and at their own expense to attend the interview. The application will close on Friday, 16 October 2026 (Jakarta Time). Enquiries Enquiries concerning the position should be sent to job@hketojakarta.gov.hk. General Notes Offer of appointment will be subject to passing all recruitment formalities including reference, medical and security checks; The terms of appointment and conditions of service to be offered are subject to the provisions prevailing at the time the offer of appointment is made; and As an Equal Opportunities Employer, the vacancy advertised is open to all applicants meeting the entry requirement irrespective of their disability, sex, marital status, pregnancy, age, family status, religion, sexual orientation and race. About InvestHK InvestHK is a department of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government responsible for attracting inward investment. Its mission is to promote and strengthen Hong Kong as Asia’s leading international business and financial centre by attracting economically and strategically important overseas and Mainland companies to invest in Hong Kong.
